step: Audit generic Linux preview ELF dependency policy
scope: Local execution of the current generic preview producer ELF audit against preserved 5.1 Full/Mini runtime files. Only GitHub expressions are replaced by actual profile/version/build-list inputs; temporary workspace/install/build links relocate inputs. This reuses the recorded Ubuntu 22.04 producer, with no new build, consumer, distro, architecture or hosted result.

profiles.name: full
profiles.script:
set -euo pipefail
scratch=/tmp/opencv51-soname-06e4460/full
mkdir -p "$scratch/repo/scripts" "$scratch/repo/build/native-linked" "$scratch/artifacts/opencv-install/opencv-5.1.0-ubuntu.22.04-x64"
ln -s /repo-input/scripts/Get-OpenCvElfSoversion.sh "$scratch/repo/scripts/Get-OpenCvElfSoversion.sh"
ln -s /workspace/linux51-output/full-runtime "$scratch/artifacts/opencv-install/opencv-5.1.0-ubuntu.22.04-x64/lib"
ln -s /workspace/linux51-output/full-runtime/libJYPPX.OpenCV.Native.so "$scratch/repo/build/native-linked/libJYPPX.OpenCV.Native.so"
export GITHUB_WORKSPACE="$scratch/repo"
export GITHUB_OUTPUT="$scratch/github-output.txt"
cd "$scratch/repo"
set -euo pipefail
profile='full'
case "$profile" in
  full)
    expected_module_count=17
    expected_canonical_count=18
    expected_runtime_file_count=52
    expected_direct_opencv=17
    ;;
  mini)
    expected_module_count=6
    expected_canonical_count=7
    expected_runtime_file_count=19
    expected_direct_opencv=6
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Unsupported generic Linux preview profile: $profile" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
IFS=',' read -r -a required_modules <<< 'core,imgproc,imgcodecs,videoio,flann,geometry,calib,stereo,dnn,ml,objdetect,photo,features,video,highgui,stitching,ptcloud'
test "${#required_modules[@]}" -eq "$expected_module_count"

workspace_root="$(dirname "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE")"
open_cv_install_dir="$workspace_root/artifacts/opencv-install/opencv-5.1.0-ubuntu.22.04-x64"
open_cv_runtime_dir=""
for candidate in "$open_cv_install_dir/lib" "$open_cv_install_dir/lib64"; do
  if [ -d "$candidate" ]; then
    open_cv_runtime_dir="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done
test -n "$open_cv_runtime_dir"

audit_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build/native-generic-linux-audit"
rm -rf "$audit_dir"
mkdir -p "$audit_dir"
cp -a "$open_cv_runtime_dir"/libopencv_*.so* "$audit_dir/"
cp build/native-linked/libJYPPX.OpenCV.Native.so "$audit_dir/"

opencv_elf_soversion="$(sh ./scripts/Get-OpenCvElfSoversion.sh '5.1.0')"
expected_names="$audit_dir/expected-runtime-files.txt"
actual_names="$audit_dir/actual-runtime-files.txt"
printf '%s\n' 'libJYPPX.OpenCV.Native.so' > "$expected_names"
for module in "${required_modules[@]}"; do
  printf '%s\n' \
    "libopencv_${module}.so" \
    "libopencv_${module}.so.${opencv_elf_soversion}" \
    "libopencv_${module}.so.5.1.0" \
    >> "$expected_names"
done
find "$audit_dir" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 \( -type f -o -type l \) \
  ! -name 'expected-runtime-files.txt' \
  ! -name 'actual-runtime-files.txt' \
  -printf '%f\n' | sort > "$actual_names"
sort -o "$expected_names" "$expected_names"
test "$(wc -l < "$actual_names")" -eq "$expected_runtime_file_count"
diff -u "$expected_names" "$actual_names"

mapfile -t opencv_elfs < <(find "$audit_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'libopencv_*.so.5.1.0' | sort)
test "${#opencv_elfs[@]}" -eq "$expected_module_count"
elf_files=("$audit_dir/libJYPPX.OpenCV.Native.so" "${opencv_elfs[@]}")
test "${#elf_files[@]}" -eq "$expected_canonical_count"

machine_count=0
origin_count=0
producer_path_count=0
missing_dependency_count=0
external_distro_dependency_count=0
for elf in "${elf_files[@]}"; do
  test -f "$elf"
  readelf -h "$elf" | grep -q 'Machine:.*Advanced Micro Devices X86-64'
  machine_count=$((machine_count + 1))
  dynamic_paths="$(readelf -d "$elf" | grep -E '\((RPATH|RUNPATH)\)' || true)"
  printf '%s\n' "$dynamic_paths"
  printf '%s\n' "$dynamic_paths" | grep -Fq '$ORIGIN'
  origin_count=$((origin_count + 1))
  if printf '%s\n' "$dynamic_paths" | grep -Eq '(\[|:)(/[A-Za-z0-9]|[A-Za-z]:)'; then
    producer_path_count=$((producer_path_count + 1))
  fi
  missing="$(ldd "$elf" | grep 'not found' || true)"
  if [ -n "$missing" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$missing" >&2
    missing_dependency_count=$((missing_dependency_count + 1))
  fi
  needed="$(readelf -d "$elf" | sed -n 's/.*Shared library: \[\([^]]*\)\].*/\1/p')"
  forbidden="$(printf '%s\n' "$needed" | grep -Ei '(^|lib)(jpeg|png|tiff|webp|openjp2|jasper|openexr|iex|imath|ilm|gstreamer|gtk|v4l|protobuf|z|avif|aom|va|opencl|tbb|lapack|blas)' || true)"
  if [ -n "$forbidden" ]; then
    printf 'GENERIC_LINUX_PREVIEW_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY file=%s\n%s\n' "$elf" "$forbidden" >&2
    external_distro_dependency_count=$((external_distro_dependency_count + 1))
  fi
done

direct_opencv_dependencies="$(readelf -d "$audit_dir/libJYPPX.OpenCV.Native.so" | grep NEEDED | grep -c "libopencv_.*[.]so[.]${opencv_elf_soversion}]")"
test "$machine_count" -eq "$expected_canonical_count"
test "$origin_count" -eq "$expected_canonical_count"
test "$producer_path_count" -eq 0
test "$direct_opencv_dependencies" -eq "$expected_direct_opencv"
test "$missing_dependency_count" -eq 0
test "$external_distro_dependency_count" -eq 0
audit_evidence="GENERIC_LINUX_PREVIEW_ELF_EVIDENCE profile=$profile files=$expected_canonical_count runtime_files=$expected_runtime_file_count machine=X86-64 origin=$expected_canonical_count producer_paths=0 direct_opencv=$expected_direct_opencv missing_dependencies=0 external_distro_dependencies=0 policy=bundled-codecs-bundled-protobuf-glibc-cxx-system-only-v2"
echo "$audit_evidence"
echo "elf_audit_evidence=$audit_evidence" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
